description: This Java source file defines the PolicyPersistenceOperationsActor class, which extends AbstractPersistenceOperationsActor. It is responsible for handling persistence operations related to policies in an event-sourcing context, specifically integrating with MongoDB using reactive streams and Akka actors. The class includes a factory method to create Props for actor instantiation, configuring connections to MongoDB and setting up persistence components.
